title: Finite-Sample Guarantees for Fully Discrete Conditional Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.13851v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We establish finite-sample guarantees for conditional diffusion models learned from data and implemented with finitely many denoising steps. Our approach aligns the score-training objective with the sampling grid, allowing statistical estimation and numerical discretization errors to be analyzed together. Under a smooth conditional density model, we derive high-probability bounds on the generated distribution's error and quantify the required number of score evaluations. For every smoothness index $\beta>0$, a suitable grid yields averaged conditional Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence $\widetilde O_p(n^{-2\beta/(d_x+d_y+2\beta)})$ relative to the original target with or without early stopping. Both the full and early-stopped samplers attain average target total-variation (TV) error $\widetilde O_p(n^{-\beta/(d_x+d_y+2\beta)})$. Here $n$ is the sample size, $d_x,d_y$ are the data and conditioning dimensions, and errors are averaged over

translated_title: 全离散条件扩散模型的有限样本保证
translated_abstract: 我们为从数据中学习并以有限个去噪步骤实现的条件扩散模型建立了有限样本理论保证。我们的方法将分数训练目标与采样网格对齐，从而能够对统计估计误差与数值离散化误差进行联合分析。在光滑条件密度模型下，我们推导出所生成分布误差的高概率上界，并量化了所需的分数评估次数。对于每一个光滑度指标 $\beta>0$，选择合适的网格后，无论是否采用提前停止，均可获得相对于原始目标的平均条件 Kullback–Leibler (KL) 散度 $\widetilde O_p(n^{-2\beta/(d_x+d_y+2\beta)})$。完整采样器与提前停止采样器均能达到平均目标总变差 (TV) 误差 $\widetilde O_p(n^{-\beta/(d_x+d_y+2\beta)})$。其中 $n$ 为样本量，$d_x,d_y$ 分别为数据维度与条件变量维度，误差在（原文此处截断）上取平均。
tldr: 本文为以有限去噪步数实现的条件扩散模型建立了首个有限样本理论保证，通过将分数训练目标与采样网格对齐来联合分析统计估计与数值离散化误差，获得了近优的KL散度与总变差误差收敛速率。
